sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Run Gun Robots is a simple yet addictive game that combines the speed and agility of a classic run-and-gun game with the strategy and depth of a platformer. The gameplay is divided into levels, each with its own unique layout and enemy placement. Your goal is to navigate through each level, avoiding deadly traps and enemy robots while collecting power-ups and upgrades to help you on your quest.

The controls are simple and easy to learn, making it accessible to players of all skill levels. On mobile devices, you can simply tap the screen to jump, shoot, or pass through a platform. On keyboard, you can use the W or Up key to jump, the X or Spacebar to shoot, and the S or Down key to pass through a platform. On gamepads, you can use the A or LT button to jump, the B or RT button to shoot, and the D-pad Down to pass through a platform.

As you progress through each level, you'll encounter a variety of enemy robots, each with its own unique abilities and weaknesses. Some will shoot lasers, while others will charge at you with speed. By using your power-ups and upgrades effectively, you'll be able to take down even the toughest enemies and unlock new levels and rewards.

One of the key features of Run Gun Robots is its use of power-ups and upgrades. By collecting coins and completing levels, you'll be able to purchase new power-ups and upgrades that will help you on your quest. Some power-ups will give you temporary invincibility or increased speed, while others will grant you new abilities, such as the ability to shoot multiple projectiles or jump higher.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Run Gun Robots are simple yet addictive, making it a great game for players of all skill levels.
